_doc: Per-project settings for the loop: how the change reaches the dev box, what must be built on Windows first, and where to test. Keyed by the repo directory name. Edit freely; nothing here is committed to any repo.

dev._doc: ssh alias 'devbox' in ~/.ssh/config (WSL) pointing at host, port, user and key above.

frontend._doc: Each build runs on Windows through cmd.exe when one of its triggers changed. A changed path under resources/ that matches no specific build runs every build. Outputs are gitignored, so they are copied as include_after_build.

qa._pages_doc: Named pages a scenario may refer to as page:<name>; {placeholders} are filled from a recipe result or the scenario. Filled in from the route files.
qa.browser_config_doc: Pass as --config on every playwright-cli open. Use Chrome's --host-resolver-rules there to pin dev hostnames to the dev box when public DNS points elsewhere.

_jump._doc: Optional jump host. WSL ssh needs the key in OpenSSH format (puttygen export), and a ProxyJump entry in ~/.ssh/config if the dev box sits behind it.
